title: Reversible transformations of sulfamethoxazole and its submoieties by manganese-oxidizing bacteria and biogenic manganese oxides in the presence of humic substances
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00593G, Paper
Adam Sochacki, Hana Šubrtová Salmonová, Sylwia Bajkacz, Ewa Felis, Lucie Schneider, Zdeněk Chval, Zuzana Vaňková, Martin Lexa, Michael Pohořelý, Philippe François-Xavier Corvini, Markéta Marečková
The transformation of sulfamethoxazole by manganese-oxidizing bacteria or biogenic manganese oxides yielded reversible conjugates with model humic substances. This can have a potential impact on the safety of drinking water and the environment.
